title: runbook template variables
description: Values for templates/runbook.md.j2 and templates/runbook.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from runbook.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

compliance_contact.title: Compliance contact
compliance_contact.description: Who must be told when this incident touches regulated data or a regulated decision? One named human on the legal or compliance side, with the notification clock they work to.

dashboard_path.title: Dashboard path
dashboard_path.description: Which dashboard confirms the signal in step 1 - the URL or path an on-call opens first, with no clicking around?

drill_completed_at.title: Drill completed at
drill_completed_at.description: When was this runbook last drilled end to end, as YYYY-MM-DD? An undrilled runbook is a document, not a control, and this date is what an auditor asks for.

incident_channel.title: Incident channel
incident_channel.description: Which channel does the incident run in - the one place status is written down while it is happening? Create it before the drill, not during the incident.

incident_class.title: Incident class
incident_class.description: Which class of incident does this runbook cover - one class per runbook? A runbook that covers everything is read by nobody at minute three.

killswitch_endpoint.title: Killswitch endpoint
killswitch_endpoint.description: Which endpoint disables the feature outright in step 4? The exact path to POST; a kill-switch nobody can name is a kill-switch nobody uses.

primary_escalation.title: Primary escalation
primary_escalation.description: Who is paged at minute 10 if the incident is not contained? One named human or one named rota that actually pages a phone, never a channel nobody watches at 3am.

secondary_escalation.title: Secondary escalation
secondary_escalation.description: Who is paged at minute 25 when the primary has not answered or cannot resolve it? Must be someone with authority the primary does not have.

threshold_1.title: Threshold 1
threshold_1.description: Above what value on that dashboard is the signal confirmed rather than noise? The number that separates 'act' from 'keep watching'.

throttle_endpoint.title: Throttle endpoint
throttle_endpoint.description: Which endpoint throttles this feature in step 2? The exact path to POST, so it can be pasted rather than remembered.
